name: Batou
line: Takes small, well-defined coding tasks: one deliverable per run, built and tested before the push.

name: Togusa
line: Builds every agent pull request and uses it on desktop and phone, then gives the verdict the merge waits for.

name: Tachikoma
line: Builds one finished small app each night, in a language and an idea that haven't been done before.

name: Ishikawa
line: Researches from primary sources, writes the plan for hard tasks, reviews code, and keeps a read-only watch on the stack.
